name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 4 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2026-05-21, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
